title: Engineering Service Catalog — Overview
body: The Acme Engineering service catalog tracks every production service, its owning team, tier, and links to runbooks and on-call rotations. Featured entries: payments-service (Tier-0, owned by the Payments team, tech lead Priya Natarajan), checkout-service (Tier-0, owned by Commerce), ledger-service (Tier-1, owned by Payments), inventory-service (Tier-1, owned by Commerce). Add a new service by filing a catalog-entry request in #eng-platform; every Tier-0/1 service must have a runbook before it's marked production-ready.
